facts.text: John expressed a passion for veterans and their rights, and mentioned working on a project to support them.

evidence.quote: I've always been passionate about veterans and their rights. Last week, I realized again how much they've done for us and wanted to show my appreciation in some way. So, I worked on a project to support them.
Been real busy tackling a project to support military veterans.

facts.text: John described the project as taking a lot of work but worth it, as he wanted to let veterans know their hard work is appreciated.

evidence.quote: It's my way of giving back. It sure has taken a lot of work, but I think it's worth it. Just want to let them know their hard work is appreciated.
